layers.prompt: Create a new animation background plate matching the attached C concept's tactile ivory paper, teal cloth binding, delicate watercolor storybook art direction. Use the attached image as STYLE REFERENCE, not a composition to preserve. ONE landscape 3:2 image: a beautiful Chinese cloth-bound picture book lying fully OPEN and FLAT, viewed EXACTLY from directly overhead, orthographic, zero camera tilt or rotation. Full book edges inside the frame, central straight gutter at precisely 50% image width. The two facing paper leaves are rectangular with softly rounded corners; left page x=10% to50%, right page x=50% to90%, page top y=13%, bottom y=87%. Both pages completely blank, warm pale ivory with subtle handmade fibres and a few fine irregularities, evenly lit. Thin page stack, understated teal cloth cover visible around the edges, clean pale ivory surrounding surface. This is the blank book plate for an actual paper-mesh animation, so NO text, symbols, title, map, illustration, mountains, bridge, city, trees, clouds, pop-up elements, hands, props, hard cast shadows, curled sheets or lifted page. Match the bright refined contemporary children's watercolor-book material, not an aged brown antique. Realistic matte paper and cloth, gentle diffuse daylight, no watermark or interface.

Create ONE isolated paper-theatre illustration asset for the attached C-style Chinese history storybook animation. The attached picture is STYLE REFERENCE. On a TRUE TRANSPARENT background: one coherent layered silhouette of three jade and turquoise Chinese shan-shui mountains with cream paper-cut edges and delicately painted watercolor texture, a tiny pale-blue winding river visible in the lower foothills. The mountain group is a single continuous folded-paper scenic insert viewed from straight in front, NOT an angled book or a whole scene. Gently uneven peaks, middle peak tallest, smaller hills either side, complete all peaks, generous transparent margins. The entire lower edge of the insert is a roughly horizontal paper base so it can hinge flat onto a page. Richly detailed fine ink and watercolor/gouache, matte handmade paper, same warm cream and luminous greens as the reference, sophisticated children's pop-up atlas style. NO book, page, desk, sky, rectangular background, people, city gate, buildings, bridges, clouds, stand, sticks, typography, letters, labels, watermark or drop shadow. Only the cutout mountain-and-foothill paper silhouette, completely isolated with real alpha transparency.

Create ONE isolated watercolor paper-theatre foreground insert for the attached Chinese history C-style storybook. STYLE REFERENCE only. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Front-facing single coherent paper-cut silhouette: a small refined warm-ochre Chinese city gate with tiled orange roof on the RIGHT, a graceful low stone arch bridge over a little painted blue river at the LOWER LEFT, and a small pink flowering tree joining the two, a continuous shallow strip of pale green grass as the bottom edge. The group is wide and low, with generous transparent margins and its entire top and bottom visible. The gate and bridge are delicately painted matte cream-edged folded paper, fine ink outlines and soft watercolor/gouache, believable and exquisite contemporary children's pop-up book craftsmanship. The imagined architecture is decorative, not a claim about a particular dynasty or excavated city. One gate, one bridge, a single low tree; no extra buildings or mountains. NO book, pages, desk, rectangular background, sky, clouds, stands, sticks, text, labels, characters, people, weapons, modern objects, glowing effects, cast shadow or watermark. Only the complete isolated paper silhouette with real alpha transparency.
